pairs.shared: Both buy a similar share of their wheat from abroad: 58.2% for Egypt, 60.8% for Italy.
pairs.differs: Italy went into the year holding about 4.1 months of wheat use in store. Egypt held about 1.3 months.
pairs.so_what: The same interruption would give Italy more time to find other supply than Egypt would have. Stocks are an estimate, not a count, and time is not the same thing as money to buy with.
